definitions.explanation: A copy or reproduction of an original item, such as a work of art, document, or digital file. Implies a faithful reproduction rather than a rough copy.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{名画|めいが}→名画：17385_meiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{複製|ふくせい}です。
examples.english: This is a reproduction of a famous painting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な⟦ファイル→ファイル：05280_fairu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{複製|ふくせい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おいた。
examples.english: I made a copy of the important file.

examples.japanese: ⟦{著作権|ちょさくけん}→著作権：14022_chosakuken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{複製|ふくせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧だ。
examples.english: It is illegal to reproduce copyrighted works without permission.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both for physical reproductions (art replicas, document copies) and digital copies (file duplication). In legal and copyright contexts, {複製|ふくせい}{権|けん} (reproduction rights) is a key concept.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {複製|ふくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make a reproduction)
- {複製|ふくせい}{品|ひん} (replica, reproduction item)
- {複製|ふくせい}{権|けん} (reproduction rights)
- ⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧{複製|ふくせい} (unauthorized reproduction)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦コピー→コピー：04883_kopii⟧: copy — more casual, everyday term
- ⟦{模造|もぞう}→模造：18492_mozou⟧: imitation — often implies lower quality or intent to deceive
- ⟦{複写|ふくしゃ}→複写：19000_fukusha⟧: copying, duplication — more technical, used for documents
